explicitly_not_done: No date was altered, no earlier time was invented, and no retroactive pre-registration is claimed. The original configs and reports are left byte-identical; this file is the only record of the finding.
finding: The self-declared `frozen_utc: 2026-10-11T12:00:00Z` in both configs is LATER than every observed Stage 3A artifact (first run record ~07:37Z, last ~08:10Z, report generated 08:17Z). A freeze timestamp cannot postdate the evaluation it claims to precede. The declared value is therefore not a truthful record of when the configs were frozen and cannot be used to support a pre-registration claim.

weaker_consistent_evidence: Filesystem mtimes place the last config modification (~07:35Z) about two minutes before the first run record (~07:37Z), which is ordering-consistent with 'configured before evaluation'. This is WEAK evidence: mtimes are mutable by ordinary file operations, carry no tamper-evident signature, and can be rewritten.
